name: Camp Timber at Bridgewater YMCA
description_short: Ten week YMCA day camp at the Bridgewater YMCA for children entering K to grade 10: Kindercamp, a traditional multi-activity camp for grades 1 to 7 with daily swim lessons and an archery range, and a counselor in training program for grades 8 to 10.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund for cancellations before May 1, 2026; after that the Y keeps $50 per week per child, except for documented medical reasons.
swim_waterfront_notes: Daily swim lessons and free swim in the Y's indoor pool.
notes: Camp 9 am to 4:30 pm; before care 7:30 to 9 am and after care 4:30 to 6 pm. Kindercamp for children entering kindergarten; traditional camp for grades 1 to 7; CIT for grades 8 to 10 in five 2 week sessions. Optional Wednesday trips cost extra and include bus transport. Fees are charged 14 days before each session. Y members get member pricing; the page shows no rates.
